environment.description: AWS Lambda function deployed in a VPC configuration with subnet associations limited to subnet-0x7f3a (10.4.12.0/24) and subnet-0x8e2b (10.4.13.0/24). These subnets are associated with route table rtb-0d4f9a which contains only local VPC routes (10.4.0.0/16 → local) and a VPC endpoint route for com.amazonaws.us-east-1.ssm (vpce-0ab12cd34). No NAT Gateway or NAT Instance is provisioned in the VPC. The VPC has no Internet Gateway attached. Security group sg-0f1a2b3c applied to the Lambda ENIs permits outbound TCP 443 only to prefix list pl-63a5400a (com.amazonaws.us-east-1.ssm). DNS resolution uses Route 53 Resolver inbound endpoint with forwarding rules for amazonaws.com domains only. The API Gateway invocation uses a VPC Link with NLB target, and the Lambda function URL is not enabled.

config.dns_resolver: Route 53 Resolver inbound, forwarding amazonaws.com only
